display.purpose: Homepage promise and major reveal headings.

chinese-name.purpose: Generated names and character studies only.

shadows.name: popover-lift
shadows.purpose: Temporary menus and date overlays only.

motion.name: name-reveal
motion.purpose: The single meaningful result reveal; replace with crossfade under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.450 0.150 20); color: oklch(1 0 0); border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 22px; font: 600 14px/1.3 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.340 0.120 20); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.340 0.120 245); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A subordinate action with no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.180 0.015 20); border: 1px solid oklch(0.880 0.010 20); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 22px; font: 600 14px/1.3 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.970 0.006 20); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.340 0.120 245); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: A selection-led input for qualities and preferences.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; background: oklch(0.940 0.025 20); color: oklch(0.340 0.120 20); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.3 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: oklch(0.450 0.150 20); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.340 0.120 245); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Persistent-label input for the two unavoidable text fields.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: oklch(0.180 0.015 20); font: 600 14px/1.3 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.180 0.015 20); border: 1px solid oklch(0.880 0.010 20); border-radius: 8px; padding: 13px 14px; font: 400 16px/1.6 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.340 0.120 245); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Name Card
components.description: The exportable keepsake; the name carries the visual weight.
components.html:
林知远

Lín Zhīyuǎn

Awareness with a far-reaching vision.

Named in Hanzi
components.css: .ds-name-card { width: min(100%, 440px); background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.180 0.015 20); border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgb(24 16 16 / .10); font: 400 16px/1.6 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-name { color: oklch(0.450 0.150 20); font: 600 72px/1.05 'Noto Serif SC', 'Songti SC', serif; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-pinyin { font-weight: 600; } .ds-name-card small { color: oklch(0.460 0.018 20); }

narrative.northStar: A single lacquer seal under white museum light.
narrative.overview: A contemporary cultural gallery that is calm, precise, and personal. Chinese characters carry the expression; the surrounding interface stays familiar and quiet.

rules.name: The One Red Mark Rule
rules.body: Use oxblood for one primary action or focal signal per view.

rules.name: The Characters Earn the Drama Rule
rules.body: Chinese names carry the expressive weight; English UI text stays clear and unornamented.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Elevation indicates a temporary layer or tangible exportable object.

dos: Use literal white as the primary canvas.
Let one name or task dominate each viewport.
Provide visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not use faux calligraphy, parchment, red-and-gold decoration, dragons, lanterns, or temple imagery.
Do not imitate generic AI tools with gradients, sparkle icons, or glowing controls.
